135: 		return err
136: 	}

138: 	builder, err := c.BuilderLister.Builders(namespace).Get(builderName)
139: 	if k8serrors.IsNotFound(err) {
140: 		return nil
141: 	} else if err != nil {
142: 		return err
143: 	}

148: 	if creationError != nil {

152: 		if err != nil {
153: 			return err
154: 		}
155: 		return creationError
156: 	}

159: 	return c.updateStatus(ctx, builder)
